title: Web-Browsing LLMs Can Access Social Media Profiles and Infer User Demographics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the demographic classification accuracy (age, gender, socioeconomic status, and political orientation) of web-browsing LLMs between male and female social media profiles using both synthetic accounts and a real survey dataset.

Comparing the demographic classification accuracy of web-browsing LLMs across users with different political orientations (liberal, moderate, and conservative) using both synthetic accounts and a real survey dataset.
